title: Is it wrong to eat plants?

vocabulary.meaning: the debated idea that plants may have some capacity for sensation or awareness
examples: Plant sentience is an important idea when discussing is it wrong to eat plants?.
Learning about plant sentience can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: principles used to judge what is right or wrong
examples: People often have different views about ethics when discussing is it wrong to eat plants?.

vocabulary.meaning: awareness of oneself and one's surroundings

vocabulary.meaning: the ability to experience and recognise pain
examples: Pain perception can play an important role in debates about is it wrong to eat plants?.

vocabulary.meaning: the degree to which an entity is considered deserving of ethical consideration

vocabulary.meaning: research findings or observations used to support or challenge a claim
